summary: Implemented Discover feature with paginated feed, category filtering, and mock data; added Scaffold-based bottom navigation for Home/Discover tabs; fixed coroutine context management and test naming
tests: Unit tests (DiscoverViewModelTest): 6 tests covering initial load, category filtering, pagination append, end-of-results detection, filter clearing, and category-specific paper loading. All unit tests pass with StandardTestDispatcher. Compilation successful with no warnings. Verified: ./gradlew :app:compileDebugSources :app:testDebugUnitTest BUILD SUCCESSFUL. All issues fixed: (1) MainNavigation refactored to use Scaffold with bottomBar to ensure NavigationBar is visible and users can switch tabs, (2) loadPage() now uses explicit withContext(Dispatchers.Main) for clear coroutine context management, (3) test renamed from misleading 'category with no papers shows empty state' to 'filtering by category loads papers for that category' with proper assertions.
